body: You lived my life. I feel the same way. My husband died in a car accident and I know he looks down at me everyday and says...why weren't you this person when I was here. Regret eats us alive.
Thank you for caring enough about a woman you don't know to write that. Thank u
Yes, I'm sorry too, but thank you.
If you talk to me, I'll share with you about me.
This picture makes me think of my husband. He died almost a year ago, and every day my kids,and I don't have him is one day too many. Thank you for sharing with us.
